resources.string: A MeshCore radio carries your OSHI messages over MeshCore repeaters. It must run MeshCore companion firmware and asks for its PIN the first time. OSHI adds one channel, #oshi-bridge, in a free slot and never changes your other channels.
With a Meshtastic and a MeshCore radio both connected, this phone repeats OSHI messages between the two networks while OSHI is running.
All 8 channel slots on this radio are in use. Free one in the MeshCore app so OSHI can add #oshi-bridge.
